verses.en: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.pt: Então Elias, o tisbita, que habitava em Gileade, disse a Acabe: Vive o Senhor, Deus de Israel, em cuja presença estou, que nestes anos não haverá orvalho nem chuva, senão segundo a minha palavra.
verses.en_web: Elijah the Tishbite, who was one of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
verses.en_bbe: And Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, By the living Lord, the God of Israel, whose servant I am, there will be no dew or rain in these years, but only at my word.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.pt: Depois veio a Elias a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

verses.en: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.pt: Retira-te daqui, vai para a banda de oriente, e esconde-te junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está ao oriente do Jordão.
verses.en_web: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: Go from here in the direction of the east, and keep yourself in a secret place by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.

verses.en: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
verses.pt: Beberás do ribeiro; e eu tenho ordenado aos corvos que ali te sustentem.
verses.en_web: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
verses.en_bbe: The water of the stream will be your drink, and by my orders the ravens will give you food there.

verses.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.pt: Partiu, pois, e fez conforme a palavra do Senhor; foi habitar junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está ao oriente do Jordão.
verses.en_web: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word; for he went and lived by the brook Cherith that is before the Jordan.
verses.en_bbe: So he went and did as the Lord said, living by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.

verses.en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.pt: E os corvos lhe traziam pão e carne pela manhã, como também pão e carne à tarde; e ele bebia do ribeiro.
verses.en_web: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
verses.en_bbe: And the ravens took him bread in the morning and meat in the evening; and the water of the stream was his drink.

verses.en: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.pt: Mas, decorridos alguns dias, o ribeiro secou, porque não tinha havido chuva na terra.
verses.en_web: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
verses.en_bbe: Now after a time the stream became dry, because there was no rain in the land.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
verses.pt: Veio-lhe então a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

verses.en: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, vai para Sarepta, que pertence a Sidom, e habita ali; eis que eu ordenei a uma mulher viúva ali que te sustente.
verses.en_web: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
verses.en_bbe: Up! go now to Zarephath, in Zidon, and make your living-place there; I have given orders to a widow woman there to see that you have food.

verses.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.pt: Levantou-se, pois, e foi para Sarepta. Chegando ele à porta da cidade, eis que estava ali uma mulher viúva apanhando lenha; ele a chamou e lhe disse: Traze-me, peço-te, num vaso um pouco d'água, para eu beber.
verses.en_web: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her, and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”
verses.en_bbe: So he got up and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the door of the town, he saw a widow woman getting sticks together; and crying out to her he said, Will you give me a little water in a vessel for my drink?

verses.en: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
verses.pt: Quando ela ia buscá-la, ele a chamou e lhe disse: Traze-me também um bocado de pão contigo.
verses.en_web: As she was going to get it, he called to her, and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
verses.en_bbe: And when she was going to get it, he said to her, And get me with it a small bit of bread.

verses.en: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.pt: Ela, porém, respondeu: Vive o Senhor teu Deus, que não tenho nem um bolo, senão somente um punhado de farinha na vasilha, e um pouco de azeite na botija; e eis que estou apanhando uns dois gravetos, para ir prepará-lo para mim e para meu filho, a fim de que o comamos, e morramos.
verses.en_web: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have a cake, but a handful of meal in a jar, and a little oil in a jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
verses.en_bbe: Then she said, By the life of the Lord your God, I have nothing but a little meal in my store, and a drop of oil in the bottle; and now I am getting two sticks together so that I may go in and make it ready for me and my son, so that we may have a meal before our death.

verses.en: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe disse Elias: Não temas; vai, faze como disseste; porém, faze disso primeiro para mim um bolo pequeno, e traze-mo aqui; depois o farás para ti e para teu filho.
verses.en_web: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
verses.en_bbe: And Elijah said to her, Have no fear; go and do as you have said, but first make me a little cake of it and come and give it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
verses.pt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: A farinha da vasilha não se acabará, e o azeite da botija não faltará, até o dia em que o Senhor dê chuva sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh, the God of Israel says, ‘The jar of meal will not run out, and the jar of oil will not fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”
verses.en_bbe: For this is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: The store of meal will not come to an end, and the bottle will never be without oil, till the day when the Lord sends rain on the earth.

verses.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.pt: Ela foi e fez conforme a palavra de Elias; e assim comeram, ele, e ela e a sua casa, durante muitos dias.
verses.en_web: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah; and she, and he, and her house, ate many days.
verses.en_bbe: So she went and did as Elijah said; and she and he and her family had food for a long time.

verses.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
verses.pt: Da vasilha a farinha não se acabou, e da botija o azeite não faltou, conforme a palavra do Senhor, que ele falara por intermédio de Elias.
verses.en_web: The jar of meal didn’t run out, and the jar of oil did not fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
verses.en_bbe: The store of meal did not come to an end, and the bottle was never without oil, as the Lord had said by the mouth of Elijah.

verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.pt: Depois destas coisas aconteceu adoecer o filho desta mulher, dona da casa; e a sua doença se agravou tanto, que nele não ficou mais fôlego.
verses.en_web: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his sickness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
verses.en_bbe: Now after this, the son of the woman of the house became ill, so ill that there was no breath in him.

verses.en: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.pt: Então disse ela a Elias: Que tenho eu contigo, ó homem de Deus? Vieste tu a mim para trazeres à memória a minha iniqüidade, e matares meu filho?
verses.en_web: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
verses.en_bbe: And she said to Elijah, What have I to do with you, O man of God? have you come to put God in mind of my sin, and to put my son to death?

verses.en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe ele: Dá-me o teu filho. E ele o tomou do seu regaço, e o levou para cima, ao quarto onde ele mesmo habitava, e o deitou em sua cama.
verses.en_web: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, Give your son to me. And lifting him out of her arms, he took him up to his room and put him down on his bed.

verses.en: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.pt: E, clamando ao Senhor, disse: ç Senhor meu Deus, até sobre esta viúva, que me hospeda, trouxeste o mal, matando-lhe o filho?
verses.en_web: He cried to Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by killing her son?”
verses.en_bbe: And crying to the Lord he said, O Lord my God, have you sent evil even on the widow whose guest I am, by causing her son's death?

verses.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.
verses.pt: Então se estendeu sobre o menino três vezes, e clamou ao Senhor, dizendo: ç Senhor meu Deus, faze que a vida deste menino torne a entrar nele.
verses.en_web: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”
verses.en_bbe: And stretching herself out on the child three times, he made his prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord my God, be pleased to let this child's life come back to him again.

verses.en: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.pt: O Senhor ouviu a voz de Elias, e a vida do menino tornou a entrar nele, e ele reviveu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of Elijah, and the child's spirit came into him again, and he came back to life.

verses.en: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
verses.pt: E Elias tomou o menino, trouxe-o do quarto à casa, e o entregou a sua mãe; e disse Elias: Vês aí, teu filho vive:
verses.en_web: Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
verses.en_bbe: And Elijah took the child down from his room into the house and gave him to his mother and said to her, See, your son is living.

verses.en: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.
verses.pt: Então a mulher disse a Elias: Agora sei que tu és homem de Deus, e que a palavra do Senhor na tua boca é verdade.
verses.en_web: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the woman said to Elijah, Now I am certain that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is true.
